decisions.reason: Because it is close to the firm's existing compilation and retail knowledge, the firm can interpret early sales signals and adjust the product, making a drop unlikely.
As an illustrated music release series building on established curation and production capabilities, the firm has the absorptive capacity to learn from early reactions and refine the format.
This reissued jazz vinyl directly leverages the firm's core reissue and genre knowledge, giving very high absorptive capacity and a very low risk of being dropped.
The multi-disc box set draws on existing curation and production expertise, allowing the firm to assess and improve it, so keeping it is strongly supported.
Although a compilation CD is close to existing catalog work, its relatively generic format offers fewer learning opportunities, but the firm's related knowledge still supports keeping it.
